name: Elohim
overview: The term 'Elohim' reveals the majestic and sovereign nature of God as the Creator of all things, as seen in Genesis 1:1 where God creates the heavens and the earth. Scripture affirms the unity of God in Deuteronomy 6:4, emphasizing that the LORD our God is one, while Genesis 1:26 hints at the complexity within the Godhead when God says, 'Let us make man in our image.' This divine plurality is further illuminated by the relationship between the LORD and the Son in Psalms 2:7 and 110:1, pointing to the eternal Sonship and authority of Christ. Exodus 3:14 underscores God's self-existence and unchanging nature as 'I AM,' grounding our understanding of Elohim in the eternal, self-sufficient God who reveals Himself in Scripture.
